test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The researcher team took air ______ from the room every five minutes to rule out the possibility of a virus.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Samples**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In research or quality control, a **sample **is a subset taken from a larger group to gather information or make inferences about the entire group.
 
• So, "**Air samples**" is the correct phrase to use in this context.
 
• The word "**instances**" does not fit in this sentence and does not make sense.
 
• "**Slices**" and "**droops**" are not commonly used terms when referring to air quality testing.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *The researcher team took air samples __from the room every five minutes to rule out the possibility of a virus.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Instances**" means occurrences or examples, but it does not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 2: "**Slices**" typically refers to cutting food or objects into thin pieces, and is not applicable to air quality testing.
 
• Option 4: "**Droops**" is not a commonly used term when referring to air quality testing, and does not fit in the context of the sentence.
